message: GitHub Actions (.github/workflows/ci.yml) allows Bundler 2.6.0 ("2.6"), which does not support cooldown (added in 4.0.13), cooldown once Gemfile.lock exists (added in 4.0.14)
fix: Require Bundler 4.0.14 or later in GitHub Actions

message: Bundler 4.0.13 in GitHub Actions (.github/workflows/ci.yml) does not support cooldown once Gemfile.lock exists (added in 4.0.14)
fix: Require Bundler 4.0.14 or later in GitHub Actions

message: Bundler 2.5.6 in BUNDLED WITH (Gemfile.lock) does not support cooldown (added in 4.0.13), cooldown once Gemfile.lock exists (added in 4.0.14)
fix: Run bundle update --bundler, which locks the latest Bundler release (4.0.14 or later is needed), and commit Gemfile.lock
